kultivator.discipleui.title: Disciple
kultivator.discipleui.status.cultivation: Fills from slain monsters, meditation, pills and a share of your own meditation nearby.
kultivator.discipleui.status.ready: Bottleneck reached: it waits for you to start its breakthrough.
kultivator.discipleui.status.qi.tip: Its own qi pool, spent on the techniques you taught it.
kultivator.discipleui.status.stored.tip: Cultivation gathered while the bar is full at a bottleneck. It flows into the bar after the breakthrough.
kultivator.discipleui.tech.heading: Teach a technique
kultivator.discipleui.tech.cost: Costs you %s Qi (a fifth of your max Qi)
kultivator.discipleui.tech.low_qi: Your qi is too low to teach right now.
kultivator.discipleui.tech.none: You know no technique you could pass on yet. Arts you learn appear here.
kultivator.discipleui.tech.select: Pick a seal card to read it.
kultivator.discipleui.reason.dao: Only for a disciple who walks %s
kultivator.discipleui.orders.heading: Give an order
kultivator.discipleui.orders.hint: Orders also work by command: /kultivasi murid ikut | tinggal | meditasi | bantu
kultivator.discipleui.mode.follow.desc: Walks with you wherever you go and catches up by itself when it falls more than 24 blocks behind. Fights monsters that come close.
kultivator.discipleui.mode.stay.desc: Stays at this spot and guards it, fighting every monster within 12 blocks, then returns to its post.
kultivator.discipleui.mode.meditate.desc: Sits cross-legged at this spot and cultivates half again as fast. It only fights back when it is attacked.
kultivator.discipleui.mode.assist.desc: Fights at your side: attacks whatever you strike and whatever strikes you, using the techniques you taught it.
kultivator.discipleui.pill.heading: Pill
kultivator.discipleui.pill.empty_hand: Hold a pill in your main hand.
kultivator.discipleui.pill.give.tip: The disciple swallows one of the pills in your main hand. Pills work on disciples as on you, a little weaker.
kultivator.discipleui.pill.not_pill: This does not look like a pill. The disciple may refuse it.
kultivator.discipleui.pill.cooldown: Its body can take this pill again in %s.
kultivator.discipleui.bt.heading: Breakthrough
kultivator.discipleui.bt.chance: A roll of fate, no tribulation.
kultivator.discipleui.bt.tribulation: A small Heavenly Tribulation strikes the disciple. It is never lethal; failing weakens it and costs part of its bar.
kultivator.discipleui.bt.summit: The disciple stands at the summit of the path.
kultivator.discipleui.bt.ready: Ready! Start it while the disciple is safe.
kultivator.discipleui.bt.deviation: Not while a Qi Deviation rages.
kultivator.discipleui.bt.not_ready: Its bar must be full at the Peak stage first (%s / %s).
kultivator.discipleui.dao.heading: Dao path
kultivator.discipleui.dao.pick: Choose the disciple's Dao. The choice is forever.
kultivator.discipleui.dao.click: Click, then click again within 3 seconds to choose.
kultivator.discipleui.dao.confirm: Click again to swear the disciple to %s
kultivator.discipleui.dao.taken: The disciple already walks another Dao.
kultivator.discipleui.dao.locked: Chosen once the disciple reaches Golden Core.
kultivator.discipleui.dao.affinity: Its spiritual root resonates with this Dao
kultivator.discipleui.release.heading: Release
kultivator.discipleui.release.tip: The disciple leaves your service forever, with everything it has learned.
kultivator.discipleui.release.twice: Needs a second click to confirm.
